answer_keys.acceptable_answer: Treat the observation as exploratory and inconclusive for a treatment effect. The omitted negative control leaves a comparison gap, and the zero-response positive control means the instrument/arm may be dead or insensitive, so the apparent target pattern cannot validate the gate. Preserve and report the observation and control failures. Before a new confirmatory claim, diagnose/calibrate the instrument, include appropriate live positive and negative controls, define the independent unit and analysis, and preregister the new measurement. Twelve episodes are not automatically twelve independent runs.

do not claim confirmatory treatment effect
report failure and prospectively specify repaired follow-up
do not assume episodes are independent units
